title_ar: الرئيس المصري يستقبل الشيخ محمد الحسن ضمن وفد علماء الأمة الداعم لسوريا
title_en: The Egyptian President Receives Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan as Part of the Delegation of the Community's Scholars Supporting Syria
body_ar:
استقبل الرئيس المصري محمد مرسي يوم الخميس 13/6/2013 الشيخ محمد الحسن ضمن وفد علماء المسلمين المشارك في مؤتمر علماء الأمة الداعم للقضية السورية، وخلال اللقاء الذي جمع مرسي بالعلماء، أوضح الرئيس المصري أن ألأوضاع في سوريا تلزم الأمة بتوحيد الجهود والعمل على وقف معاناة الشعب السوري..

وأكد مرسي في السياق نفسه على موقف مصر الداعم لحق الشعب السوري في تقرير مصيره والسعي بقوة لوقف حمام الدم في هذا البلد الشقيق، والعمل على وحدة الشعب السوري والمحافظة على وحدة أرضه.

يشار إلى أن ملتقى العلماء في القاهرة أقر بيانا قويا دعا فيه بقوة إلى الوقوف مع الشعب السوري المسلم، كما دعا إلى الجهاد بالنفس والمال لنصرة هذا الشعب الذي خذلته جميع القوى الدولية، والسعي إلى إنقاذه بحزم، مما أسماه البيان بإجرام نظام طائفي، مؤكدا في الوقت نفسه أن التدخل السافر لحزب الله وإيران في سوريا يعتبر دليلا قويا على حرب معلنة على الإسلام والمسلمين، كما دعا البيان الثوار في سوريا إلى نبذ دواعي الفرقة والشقاق، وتغليب المصلحة العامة للبلد.
body_en:
The Egyptian president Muhammad Morsi received on Thursday 13/6/2013 Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan, as part of the delegation of Muslim scholars taking part in the conference of the community's scholars in support of the Syrian cause. During the meeting that brought Morsi together with the scholars, the Egyptian president made clear that the conditions in Syria oblige the community to unify its efforts and to work to stop the suffering of the Syrian people…

Morsi affirmed in the same context Egypt's position in support of the right of the Syrian people to determine its own destiny, of striving forcefully to stop the bloodbath in this sister country, and of working for the unity of the Syrian people and the preservation of the unity of its land.

It is noted that the scholars' gathering in Cairo approved a strongly worded statement in which it called forcefully for standing with the Muslim Syrian people, and called for jihad with one's self and one's wealth in support of this people, which all the international powers have failed, and for striving resolutely to rescue it from what the statement called the criminality of a sectarian regime — affirming at the same time that the flagrant intervention of Hezbollah and Iran in Syria is to be regarded as strong evidence of a declared war on Islam and the Muslims. The statement also called on the revolutionaries in Syria to cast off the occasions of division and discord, and to give precedence to the general benefit (maṣlaḥah) of the country.

flags.arabic: كما دعا إلى الجهاد بالنفس والمال لنصرة هذا الشعب
flags.context: the Cairo conference statement, as summarised by the site
options: called for jihad with one's self and one's wealth in support of this people
called for struggle with life and property in support of this people
called on people to fight and to give of their wealth in support of this people
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW. 'الجهاد بالنفس والمال' in a statement about an active armed conflict is a call to armed participation and to its funding, and cannot be softened to 'struggle'. Rendered literally with the Arabic term visible. Note carefully: this is the collective statement of the Cairo conference, NOT a ruling of the Sheikh, who appears in this record only as a member of a delegation received by the Egyptian president. The site must not present it as his fatwā. Publication in English carries clear legal exposure in several jurisdictions and is a decision for Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

flags.arabic: مما أسماه البيان بإجرام نظام طائفي
flags.context: the statement's description of the Syrian government
options: from what the statement called the criminality of a sectarian regime
from what the statement described as the crimes of a sectarian regime
flags.note: The reporter's own hedge ('مما أسماه البيان') is preserved in the English, because it is the site distancing itself from the statement's characterisation. Removing the hedge would turn the reporter's attribution into the site's own assertion.

flags.context: أوضح الرئيس المصري أن ألأوضاع في سوريا تلزم الأمة
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). A doubled alif-hamzah, evidently a keying error for 'الأوضاع'. Read through in body_en and preserved in body_ar.

translator_notes: The Sheikh is the nominal subject of the headline but says nothing in this record; the quoted content is the Egyptian president's and the conference statement's. Marked critical_for_display because a reader arriving from the title will take the statement's call for jihad as the Sheikh's position. The date in the body (13/6/2013) precedes the CMS upload of 15 June 2013. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.
